item.title: Man arraigned for 1975 North Park murder
item.description: Johnnie Salisbury, 71, was arraigned on murder charges in San Diego Superior Court on Tuesday for allegedly beating and stabbing 34-year-old Edmund LaFave in his home in 1975.

item.title: Coronado's Sandcastle Man banned from Hotel Del Coronado property
item.description: Bill Pavlacka, known as The Sandcastle Man, was told he can no longer build his sandcastles on Hotel del Coronado property after nearly 20 years, due to violating hotel policies and creating political messages.

item.title: San Diego County launches new homelessness data dashboards
item.description: San Diego County launched new dashboards on its website Tuesday, giving the public a clearer idea of how well it is meeting its goals at reducing homelessness.

item.title: George's at the Cove reopens its ocean terrace rooftop
item.description: George's at the Cove has reopened after a three-month renovation of their iconic Ocean Terrace rooftop, dining area and bar, and is offering 50% off select Hill Family Wine bottles throughout February.

item.title: Yolanda Marodi pleads not guilty to killing her Cal Fire captain wife
item.description: Yolanda Marodi pleaded not guilty to first-degree murder for the stabbing death of her wife, Rebecca Marodi, and a trial is scheduled for June.

item.title: Person detained for questioning in Nancy Guthrie search
item.description: Sources tell NewsNation the person was detained south of Tucson.

item.title: San Diego receives $7M boost from SANDAG for city upgrades
item.description: The City of San Diego has been awarded $6.9 million from SANDAG to fund five projects, including the Chollas Creek to Bayshore Bikeway, Balboa Park Master Plan, Otay Mesa - Nestor Community Plan Update, Rancho Bernardo Community Plan, and the City's Climate Action Plan Update.

item.title: Advisory issued for Carlsbad State Beach due to high bacteria levels
item.description: San Diego County has added a portion of Carlsbad State Beach to its Bacterial Exceedance Advisory list due to high bacteria levels, and beach users are advised to avoid contact with the water.

item.title: Woman with dog arrested after leading pursuit on San Diego highway
item.description: All northbound lanes of Interstate 15 near Miramar are closed due to police activity, with an unknown duration of closure.

item.title: Chula Vista community rallies behind Police Chief Kennedy amid scandal
item.description: Chula Vista community members are showing their support for Police Chief Roxana Kennedy amidst allegations that the city is trying to force her into early retirement.
